facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this. Su Muon Pagoda sits off the main drag and most visitors never find it. 606 reviews, 4.4 stars, zero tour-group crowds. Just incense smoke, quiet courtyards, and a pace that feels nothing like the beach strip. Bring respectful clothing, slow down, and actually look around. This is the Phu Quoc locals spend time in. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
